entities.summary: Jan Ladislav Dussek was a Czech classical period composer and virtuoso pianist. He was an important representative of Czech music abroad in the second half of the 18th century and the beginning of the 19th century. Some of his more forward-looking piano works have traits often associated with Romanticism. Jan Ladislav Dussek was a composers & musicians from Čáslav (1760-02-12, Čáslav–1812-03-20). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
